name: incline push press
description: An incline press with a small leg drive that lets you move heavier loads and trains the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: Set an incline bench and hold the bar at your upper chest.
Dip slightly through your legs to start momentum.
Drive the bar up while pressing with your arms.
Lock out above your chest, then lower under control.
Keep your core braced and your lower back from arching.
